```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
mallards <- readRDS("data/mallards.rds")
```

```{r}
fixes_by_month <- mallards |>
  count(month, sort = TRUE)

fixes_by_month
```

```{r}
#| warning: false
library(ggridges)

mallards_filtered <- mallards |>
  filter(speed <= 30, !is.na(speed), !is.na(month)) |>
  mutate(month = factor(month, levels = month.name, ordered = TRUE))

ggplot(mallards_filtered, aes(x = speed, y = month, fill = month)) +
  geom_density_ridges(alpha = 0.8, scale = 1.2) +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(option = "plasma") +
  labs(
    x = "Speed",
    y = "Month",
    title = "Mallard speed distributions by month"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```
